static.aboutBody: Vertex MMA is a community platform for UFC fight discussion, custom rankings, and virtual coin betting. The Vertex Score is a 0–100 measure combining quality wins, championship pedigree, recent form, finishing rate, and defensive vulnerability across every UFC fighter with three or more bouts.
static.aboutNote: A full about page lands in a later wave.
static.privacyBody: A full privacy policy lands in a later wave. In the meantime: we store the data you provide (email, username, profile fields, bets, rankings), use it to run your account, and don't share it with third parties. Auth + storage are handled by Supabase.
static.termsBody: A full terms-of-use document lands in a later wave. Quick version: virtual coins on Vertex MMA have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for real money. The platform is for entertainment.

simulationIndex.metaTitle: Vertex MMA Simulation — predictions for every upcoming UFC bout
simulationIndex.metaDescription: ML-powered winner predictions, SHAP feature attributions, and Monte Carlo round-by-round distributions for every scheduled UFC bout.
simulationIndex.heading: Simulation
simulationIndex.lead: Calibrated winner probabilities, top driving features, and Monte Carlo round-by-round distributions for every scheduled UFC bout.
simulationIndex.emptyFilteredLead: No upcoming bouts pass the current filter. Try a looser combination or wait for the next card to lock in.
simulationIndex.emptyLead: The model runs every night against the schedule. Once the next card is locked in, predictions will appear here.
simulationIndex.disclaimer: Predictions come from a LightGBM + XGBoost + LogReg ensemble trained on every historical UFC bout with isotonic-style calibration, plus a 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulator for the per-round distribution. Reflects statistical baseline only — not a betting recommendation.

scoreHistory.leadCurrent: Replay of the current-Vertex formula at each completed UFC bout. Hover the chart for the bout that locked in each value.
scoreHistory.leadAllTime: Replay of the all-time legacy formula at each bout — quality wins, championship pedigree, era dominance, performance, finishing, career peak, minus weighted losses.
scoreHistory.currentFormNote: Current is a live-form rating, so it drifts between fights: recent results age out of the rolling windows and the age curve steps on a birthday — a quiet stretch can nudge it slightly up or down with no bout. The all-time score only moves when a fighter actually competes.
scoreHistory.noReplay: No replay data — this fighter has fewer than three completed UFC bouts, so the formula has nothing to anchor on yet.
scoreHistory.noHistory: No score history available for this fighter.
scoreHistory.noAllTimeReplay: All-time replay not yet computed for this fighter — run the backfill script.
